concept: 기부금 유출의 마지막 수취계좌를 입금 명세서와 연결하는 순간
concept_authorship: Independent agent; randomized before local retrieval. Domain assignment and expectations are not additional user facts.
reference_scope: Visible face and hair appearance only; identity, age, biography and profession remain unestablished.

gates.expected: The subject purposefully compares evidence rather than posing at a desk; attention, annotation and records form one coherent investigation.
gates.pass_rule: All components and causal connection visible together.

gates.expected: The right hand holding the pencil visibly belongs to the investigator, and its tip touches the circle around the printed receiving-account row; left fingertips separately stabilize the paper.
components: left hand at separate paper corner
gates.pass_rule: Every endpoint visible; nearby pointing or hidden tip fails.

gates.expected: A screen transfer chain ends at A-17 with 9,800,000, and the foreground bank statement visibly repeats A-17 and 9,800,000; subject action targets that entry.
gates.pass_rule: All record components readable and jointly connected; approximate bookkeeping impression alone fails.

gates.expected: Visible facial shape and short dark bob with wispy fringe correspond to the supplied portrait at a usable viewing scale.
gates.pass_rule: Assess appearance only; no identity or age assertion.

gates.expected: Investigative-fiction financial evidence work is the main impression, with a traceable connection that exceeds generic office work.
gates.pass_rule: Strict conjunction; genre atmosphere alone is insufficient.

review_protocol: After one saved image, inspect actual pixels. For each gate record visible/partial/unobservable, pass/fail/unknown, evidence and limits. Source exposure, adoption, audit validity, pixels and user acceptance are distinct. User acceptance stays pending.
